snippet.title: Version "Luna VI" "Augured Homecoming" Trailer | Genshin Impact #GenshinImpact #Linnea
snippet.description:
Version "Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo" "Augured Homecoming" Trailer | Genshin Impact
From the moment we open our eyes, we begin to perceive the world.
We hear poetry, we hear songs — they guide the fae to the mortal realm, and people into endless time and space.
There is no need to feel sorrow for the past or the future, for this world is vast enough to swallow all melancholy.

VA:
